research_question: Which culturally situated entities appear in unmasked multilingual source passages, and what contextual evidence supports their local association?
inclusion_criteria: Include foods, beverages, authors, person names, locations and sports clubs when relevant to the declared study; established entities are eligible.
Retain original scripts, transliterations and ambiguous associations without replacing original evidence with generated translations.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude generic expressions without project-relevant cultural context.
Do not infer cultural identity from a person's name or language alone; a masked-out entity has no observed occurrence.
